name: application-profile-stats-bar
title: Profile Stats Bar
description: Horizontal row of tappable profile stats (posts/followers/following), each a full-height button with a bold count and a muted label, divided by hairlines.
useWhen: A social or community profile header needs to show a small fixed set of counts (posts, followers, following).
Each count should be tappable to navigate to its own list (a followers list, a posts grid).
You want equal-width, evenly divided cells rather than a free-form stat grid.
avoidWhen: The counts aren't navigable — a plain stat-tile row communicates the same numbers with less implied interactivity.
There are more than 3-4 stats — this pattern is built for a short, fixed row; use a stat grid for more metrics.
The numbers need trend or comparison context (up/down from last period) — use stat-tile or metric-sparkline-card instead.
responsiveBehavior: The bar is a fixed max-w-xs row whose cells flex evenly to fill the available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: Each stat is a real <button>, giving keyboard focus and activation without added ARIA.
Large-count formatting (e.g. '12.4K') should be paired with a full unformatted value in a title attribute or accessible label if precision matters for assistive tech users.
Dividers use border color, not spacing alone, so cell boundaries remain visible for low-vision users.

variants.title: Profile stats bar
variants.description: Three-cell row (Posts, Followers, Following) with bold counts and muted labels, each cell a tappable button.
accessibility: Each cell has a distinct hover background so its tappable boundary is visually clear before activation.

variants.title: Profile stats bar (Dark)
variants.description: Profile stats bar adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Divider and hover-state colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
